clips.title: The story
paras: Saldean's Farm is the only homestead in Westfall that has not been completely overrun and abandoned to the Defias Brotherhood. Held by the stubborn Farmer Saldean and his wife Salma, the farmhouse remains a rare safe haven amid the region's turmoil.

While neighboring lands fell to banditry and mechanical sabotage, the Saldean family refused to abandon their soil. Farmer Saldean and his wife Salma have stayed on their homestead, offering hot food and a kind word to passing travelers. Despite their resilience, the fields remain plagued by rogue harvest golems deployed across the plains, forcing the family to stay close to the farmhouse walls.
